synopsis: One Night In June is a dark drama that introduces Lydia and John, as they face a crossroads in their relationship. Through lies, betrayal and vengeful rage they both commit acts they cannot un-do. John is left with an ultimatum that will change his and Lydia's life forever. This gripping short film confronts the nature of the human experience. Our mistakes, our choices, how they impact the ones we love, and the extreme consequences we face.
